purpose: Exploratory model development; previously reused outer panel is not an untouched test set
target: All incorrect first buzzes, including zero-point incorrect answers; neg=1-correct
outer: Original five frozen year_2024 game folds, seed 42; score exact saved BUZZ event IDs
inner: Reuse tossup-accuracy-study fold-specific 80/20 whole-game splits verbatim
selection: Maximize inner validation neg average precision within each new family; also report family selected by inner AP
thresholds: Default .5; maximize accuracy; max recall with empirical precision>=.60 and >=50 predicted positives; max F1 subject to validation accuracy>=.77/.78/.806. Infeasible policies are missing, never silently converted into an all-negative policy.
calibration: No test-label calibration. Empirical constraints may fail on outer data.
features: Conditional on observed first buzzer and buzz position. Text vocabulary/SVD fit on training prefixes only, no answer strings or unrevealed tokens.
base: Reuse strongest previously selected regularized feature structure (all five folds: item spline scale3, other scales1); do not repeat old hyperparameter sweeps.
mixture: Additional validation-log-score convex combination of vb_base and whole_prefix; motivated by separating calibration and discrimination. Single validation split analogue of stacking.
bayesian: Diagonal Gaussian variational posterior, Gaussian grouped priors with type-II MAP log-scale estimates and N(0,.75^2) log-scale hyperpriors; global N(0,3^2). Not full hyperparameter Bayes. 16-point Gauss-Hermite prediction integration; Adam then LBFGS ELBO optimization using training data only.
unknown_ids: One-hot unknowns map to zero: conditional pooled-mean fallback, not prior predictive integration for unseen players. Outer unknown-player proportion below .07%; all scored questions are seen in training.
bootstrap: 1000 paired whole-game bootstrap samples; conditional on fitted predictions, no retraining, not uncertainty from repeated model selection or shared questions across games
exclusions: No new timing or identity modeling; no repeated class weighting, Bernstein dimensions, free neural interaction or timing coupling experiments.
concurrent_existing_comparator: Other task completed boosting and boosting_ensemble; read-only inclusion, not refitted by this study.
